splash.caption: Official {STEMRacing} Team!
splash.subheading: Proud winners of {awards} and Luxembourg's representatives at the {finals}

stem.title: STEM Racing
stem.subtitle: What is it?
stem.body: STEM Racing, formerly known as F1 in Schools, is an international educational program that encourages {students} to learn about science, technology, engineering, and mathematics ({stem}) through designing, building, and racing {cars}. ...
stem.imageCaption: Petar on the starting grid at World Finals 2025

item1.title: Team Creation
item1.text: In October 2022, the first generation of Icarus was formed with our original members; Celia, Nikos, Lukas, and Maria.

item2.title: National Competitions
item2.text: Throughout 2022 and 2025, we attend a total of 3 National Finals in Luxembourg, and 2 showruns, winning multiple trophies along the way.

item3.title: World Finals
item3.text: In June 2025, we qualified to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals in Singapore. We worked tirelessly all summer to then participate in September.

sponsors.title: Our Sponsors
sponsors.description: We are immensely to all our sponsors already working with us. We definitely could not have gone on this journey without them!

efg.name: EFG Bank
efg.description: EFG is our biggest sponsor. We could have not done this journey without them.

eurobank.name: EuroBank
eurobank.description: Eurobank were our first big private sponsors. We are very grateful for their support.

apeeel2.name: APEEEL
apeeel2.description: We are fortunate to have support from our school's parents' association since day one!

esl2.name: European School of Luxembourg II
esl2.description: We are supported by our school, who have provided us with a workspace and many necessary tools.

dreamcars.name: Dream Cars
dreamcars.description: Dream Cars are private car dealership in Luxembourg, who believe in our mission. Thank you!

ortea.name: Ortea
ortea.description: Ortea produce an organic iced tea in Luxembourg and were our first private sponsor.

delphis.name: Delphis Studio
delphis.description: Delphis Studio is a private 3D design studio. They helped us a advised us on many of our graphics.

ratrig.name: RatRig
ratrig.description: RatRig were were very kind to give us a discount a sped up shipping on their CNC Mill.

partnership.title: Partner With Purpose
partnership.subtitle: Fueling the Next Generation of Engineering
partnership.description: As a self-funded STEM Racing team, our journey to the World Finals is powered entirely by our partners. While financial support is critical for our operations, we highly value technical and material contributions—from precision manufacturing and 3D printing filaments to expert consultancy in aerodynamics, marketing, and visual design.
partnership.cta_note: Every contribution directly accelerates our performance on and off the track.

funds.title: Strategic Fund Allocation
funds.caption: Icarus Gen 2: Aerodynamic validation in the smoke tunnel.

allocation1.title: Global Logistics & Accommodation
allocation1.description: Ensuring the team is stationed at official venues during international World Finals.

allocation2.title: International Travel
allocation2.description: Transporting our team and equipment to global competition host cities.

allocation3.title: Competition & Entry Fees
allocation3.description: Covering mandatory team registration and individual participant accreditation.

allocation4.title: Advanced Manufacturing
allocation4.description: Sourcing official racing blocks, high-performance paints, and precision tooling.

allocation5.title: Branding & Marketing
allocation5.description: Producing team uniforms, pit displays, and high-impact marketing collateral.

allocation6.title: Sustainability Initiatives
allocation6.description: Partnering with environmental leaders to offset our carbon footprint.

benefit1.title: Education
benefit1.description: You show commitment to supporting education and the young generation.

benefit2.title: Innovation
benefit2.description: You show commitment to innovative ideas, creativity and future engineers.

benefit3.title: Global & Local Exposure
benefit3.description: STEM Racing is a very global competition, but Icarus also heavily promotes the project and themselves in Luxembourg.

benefit4.title: Experience
benefit4.description: Icarus has almost 4 years of experience in the project - by far the most in Luxembourg.

benefit5.title: Visibility Everywhere
benefit5.description: We are committed to making your investment worth it. We'll promote your logo on our materials and we can also agree on custom arrangements.

benefit6.title: Targeted Audience
benefit6.description: By partnering with us, we expose your company to top current and future professionals in the STEM fields.

tiers.title: Sponsorship Tiers
tiers.heading: Join The Pantheon
tiers.caption: Choose the sponsorship level that aligns with your goals. Every tier fuels our mission to push the boundaries of engineering excellence.
tiers.cta: Ready to fuel the future of engineering?
tiers.mailto_body: Hi, I'm interested in discussing sponsorship opportunities with your team.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.description: Our most prestigious partners. Zeus-tier sponsors provide substantial monetary support that powers our entire operation—from chassis fabrication to competition travel.
zeus.perk3: Prime logo placement in all documents and materials
zeus.requirement_description: Requires substantial monetary investment. Zeus-tier partners are our primary stakeholders, providing the capital necessary for major R&D and international competition logistics.

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.description: Strategic partners who drive our technical capabilities. Poseidon-tier sponsors contribute significantly through funding or high-value material donations that shape our car's performance.
poseidon.perk3: Logo placement in key documents and materials
poseidon.requirement_description: Open to significant monetary contributions or substantial in-kind material donations such as high-grade filaments, specialized components, or electronics suites.

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.description: The backbone of our daily operations. Demeter-tier sponsors provide essential services and support that keep our team running smoothly throughout the season.
demeter.requirement_description: Ideal for local businesses or specialists offering medium-impact technical services, printing, consulting, or entry-level financial contributions that support our day-to-day operations.

team.hero_subtitle: From engineers and designers to marketing specialists, Icarus is a collective of students driven by a shared passion for speed, innovation, and the future of STEM.

vlad.bio: This is a longer description to see whether the black backdrop will change. Leading the design and manufacturing process of the Icarus Gen 3 car, focusing on aerodynamic efficiency and weight reduction.

hall_of_fame.title: Hall of Fame
hall_of_fame.subtitle: Commemorating those who built the foundation of Icarus.

gen3.title: Generation III
gen3.description: With more experience, we focused on our biggest weakness - the sponsorships. We managed to acquire enough funds to go the World Finals. We also improved the brand image, car, and all other aspects of the team.

m1.name: Petar
m1.bio: Petar led Icarus to the World Finals in 2025. He worked closely with everyone to ensure quality and cooperation. Along with that he is in charge of the manufacturing of the cars.

m2.name: Celia
m2.bio: Celia had a diverse set of responsibilities within Icarus. She was in charge of our written and graphic deliverables, such as our portfolios, uniforms and banners. She founded Icarus and cemented the brand image.

m3.name: Nikos
m3.bio: Nikos was in charge of all design and testing of our cars. His responsibility was to develop innovative, and high-performance designs that ensure the team stayed ahead of the competition.

m4.name: Lukas
m4.bio: Lukas was the finance manager and IT specialist. Handling the budget, financial planning, and IT infrastructure, he ensured that the team operates smoothly and efficiently.

m5.name: Konstantina
m5.bio: Konstantina handled all marketing, public relations and communication with stakeholders. It was her job to maintain our strong link with the local community and beyond.

gen2.title: Generation II
gen2.description: Following the success of Gen I, we expanded to 6 members and upgraded everything in the team and started evolving into a top-tier competition in Luxembourg.

m1.name: Celia
m1.bio: Celia is the founder and past leader of Icarus. At the forefront of our team, Celia undertook numerous tasks across all fields, ranging from administration to car design.

m2.name: Nikos
m2.bio: Nikos was responsible for combining the performance and design of our car, relentlessly working on every detail in search of the greatest competitive edge.

m3.name: Lukas
m3.bio: Lukas managed our online presence. Maintaining our website and responsible for the team’s online collaboration, Lukas invaluably brought the entire team together.

m4.name: Jan
m4.bio: Jan’s creative mind not only provided us with our logo and pit display but has also been a source of significant improvement in our overall presentation.

m5.name: Rohan
m5.bio: Rohan, responsible for the team’s external communication, simultaneously looked after the team’s funds, overseeing team decisions from a financial perspective.

m6.name: Romeo
m6.bio: Romeo was in charge of our team’s marketing strategies and securing sponsorship deals for our team. In parallel, he added to all administrative tasks, working particularly closely with Rohan.

gen1.title: Generation I
gen1.description: Gen I was going into the project (still called F1 in Schools then) without 0 experience or knowledge. In just two months, we managed to create a small brand and a working car with very little guidance and help.

m1.name: Celia
m1.bio: Celia is the founder of Icarus and has led the first generation to to success. By nature, she handled many of the administrative tasks of the team.

m2.name: Nikos
m2.bio: Nikos was responsible designing and manufacturing our very first car.

m3.name: Lukas
m3.bio: Lukas led the team in all things IT, mainly creating the first team website and maintaining it.

m4.name: Maria
m4.bio: Maria was our first designer, making the first 3 versions of our logo, as well as satisfying all other needs of the team.

establishment_22.title: Establishment of the team
establishment_22.text: Being fascinated by Formula 1 and engineering, Celia decided to form a new team, quickly inviting Nikos and Lukas to join. We worked tirelessly to create the very first car, portfolios and presentation.

first_event_22.title: Our first event
first_event_22.text: Our first race at Luxembourg's highest level of competition and despite our inexperience, lack of time and resources, we won the ‘Judges’ Favorite Award.’ Such performance set our standards high and has been a source of motivation and ambition for us to strive for excellence today.

expansion_23.title: 3 new members
expansion_23.text: To help us with the increasing amount of work and our vision to qualify for the World Championships, we accepted 3 new members into the team: Jan, Rohan and Romeo.

june_event_23.title: June event
june_event_23.text: Right after our team expanded to 6 members, we took part in another event, where we were awarded the ‘Regional T1 Top Team’ for outperforming the competition since preparation.

showrun_23.title: New school year Showrun
showrun_23.text: At the beginning of the new school year in 2023, we participated in a Showrun, getting to share some of our insights with new enthusiasts and showcase our journey.

national_finals_24.title: Luxembourg National Finals
national_finals_24.text: Knowing that winning this event would take us to the World Championships, we went all-in, ensuring that everything was top-notch and of best quality. Despite doing our best, we fell short to fierce and more experienced competition. We nonetheless won the Knockout Champions and the Fastest Car Awards.

reorg_24.title: Team reorganization
reorg_24.text: Since Jan, Rohan and Romeo graduated high school in July, we were back to 3 members over the summer holidays. Our worries were however proved unnecessary, since we quickly adopted 2 new members: Petar and Konstantina into the team.

showrun_24.title: Showrun 2024
showrun_24.text: Similarly to the previous year, we were invited to the Showrun at ISL. Now being one of the most experienced teams, we shared our insights, tips and tricks with the younger participants. We also won the Best Logo Award.

prep_24_25.title: Preparation
prep_24_25.text: Together with our studies we have worked tirelessly on designing a new car, upgrading our project enterprise and project management, approaching and pitching to sponsors to give us the best possible odds for qualification to the World Finals.

national_finals_25.title: National Finals 2025
national_finals_25.text: We competed in our 3rd National Finals in May of 2025. After 3 years, we finally managed to qualify to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals in Singapore1

world_finals.title: World Finals
world_finals.text: In September, we flew as a team to Singapore to represent Luxembourg at the highest level of the STEM Racing competition - the World Finals. Although we did not win any trophies, it was nonetheless a surreal experience, which propelled Icarus to miles forward.
